title: Spawner Iron Tools 💀
description: A resourcepack that changes iron tools to be visually cobbled together spawner and bone fragments.
body:
# Iron Tools -> 💀 Spawner Tools 💀

A Minecraft resourcepack to make your iron tools look appropriately threatening.

I wish these were real items, I quite like the 'hobbled together' motif.

### Description;

A resourcepack that changes iron tools to be visually cobbled together spawner and bone fragments.
![Textures](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d69e3ea74dbdb4f2c9df6b26da3dafefb3ca1897.png)


### Other Info;

Dependencies-

No hard mod requirements.

No soft mod requirements.


Version-

Revision 0 - Minecraft 26.1+

My packs are default released for latest version of Minecraft- if you want it ported to a newer or older version let me know. _(*Done at my discretion. Some things may be too difficult to port.)_
